mapper.select: SELECT group_key, current_revision, updated_at, updated_by FROM nw_platform_operational_setting_groups WHERE group_key IN #{key}
SELECT group_key, revision, values, created_at, actor_id FROM nw_platform_operational_setting_versions WHERE (group_key = #{head.groupKey} AND revision = #{head.currentRevision})
SELECT group_key, revision, values, created_at, actor_id FROM nw_platform_operational_setting_versions WHERE group_key = #{groupKey} ORDER BY revision DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_platform_operational_setting_versions (group_key, revision, values, actor_id) VALUES (#{groupKey}, #{revision}, #{values,typeHandler=com.skillforge.core.shared.config.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{actorId}) ON CONFLICT (group_key, revision) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO nw_platform_operational_setting_groups (group_key, current_revision, updated_by) VALUES (#{groupKey}, #{revision}, #{actorId}) ON CONFLICT (group_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO nw_platform_operational_setting_audits (group_key, operation, from_revision, to_revision, target_revision, actor_id, payload) VALUES (#{groupKey}, #{operation}, #{fromRevision}, #{toRevision}, #{targetRevision}, #{actorId}, #{payload,typeHandler=com.skillforge.core.shared.config.JsonbTypeHandler})
